# Third-party component

`field_analyst_agent.md` is taken verbatim from **Academic Research Skills for
Claude Code** by Cheng-I Wu (https://github.com/Imbad0202/academic-research-skills),
licensed under **Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International**
(CC BY-NC 4.0). It is included here, with attribution, for non-commercial use
only: it powers the wildcard seat (§11 of REVIEW-INSTRUCTIONS.md), generating a
fresh Reviewer Configuration Card per run. If the full skill package is
installed under `~/.claude/skills/academic-paper-reviewer/`, that installed copy
is used instead of this one.
